newsitem.title: USA: Solv-Ex says lawsuit is without merit.
newsitem.headline: Solv-Ex says lawsuit is without merit.

text.p: Solv-Ex Corp said Wednesday a class action complaint filed against it earlier this month is without merit and the company will fight it.
Lawyers for the plaintiffs say the complaint, filed October 4, alleges misrepresentaion.
Solv-Ex said it believes short sellers are behind the complaint and are seeking to prevent Solv-Ex from financing, building and operating its first commercial oil sands plant in Alberta, Canada.
Solv-Ex said it is not aware of any investigations by regulatory authorities as to the propriety of actions taken by Solv-Ex or its management.
